title: Healthy Church: The Health of the World
series: Healthy Church: Paul's Letter to Titus
description: Why can't we all just get along? There is so much division and nastiness in the world that the question of how we live well together has perhaps never seemed more pressing.

This was a live question for Titus as he planted churches in the hostile culture of ancient Crete. The Apostle Paul instructs him in how the community of the church should relate to the community around them.
What we learn is that healthy churches care about the health of the world .

Churches do so by working for the common good of all people, energised by the blessed hope of the return of Jesus, to make all things new. That work of renewal has begun already in his people, whom the Spirit is renewing in godliness, making us agents of renewal as we wait for the Lord's return.
